notes.title: Steam Trading Cards Now Live – Start Collecting!
notes.content:
[h2]TL;DR:[/h2]
1. Mizuchi's Steam [b]trading card[/b] is now live - fire up the game and start collecting!
2. A guide to Mizuchi's [b]5 endings[/b]. Did you know all endings work together to give you a [b]satisfying emotional closure[/b]?😊
3. Mizuchi's [b]physical console release[/b] in Asia!
4. Language updates! [b]Chinese and Japanese[/b] are coming soon.
5. [b]Wishlist our upcoming game[/b] - Red Rebellion.

[i]Disclosure: This announcement is written by a fan volunteer. You may see overexcitement in the choice of words, which does not reflect the character of our writer - who's always way too modest.[/i]🤦‍♀️

[h2]1. Mizuchi's Steam trading cards are now live![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35533250/4b1d801c3eb28aa5dfa9c526412a478ab1aef094.png[/img]

One day, when casually browsing Mizuchi's Steam backend, our dev noticed something unusual- the button "trading card" was no longer greyed out. Wow! Mizuchi was now eligible for trading card drop! How nice! So, yeah, the team quickly designed the cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35533250/b877a2a710253223768de0c71ecb71774f060017.png[/img]

You can get 7 or 8 free card drops just by playing the game. Along with the card update, we've also fixed some text and added some extra stuff. If you haven't finished the game, [b]NOW is the time to jump back in![/b]

[h2]2. A guide to Mizuchi's [b]5 endings[/b]. Did you know all endings work together to give you a satisfying emotional closure?[/h2]

As a super fan, let me tell you—if you haven’t played through all the routes, you haven’t experienced the full emotional impact of the story and got all the mystery tied up.

I'm not making this up. Another critic had a similar thought - “[b]There are many layers of meaning, and it’s nice to ponder them after playing…it will leave an imprint on my gamer heart.[/b] (translated from French)”– [url=https://jrpgfr.net/2025/02/10/test-de-mizuchi-une-histoire-incroyable-et-le-reste/]JRPGFR[/url]

I know figuring out all the endings can be a mystery. We're lucky because one of our early players has whipped up a guide:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2328927189]https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2328927189[/url]

[h2]3. Mizuchi's physical console release in Asia![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35533250/05551e350f6fd300633af429bbffe011b1247683.png[/img]

It’s surreal to see a physical copy of Mizuchi finally in the hands of one of our teammates!

This wouldn’t have been possible without the support from our early fans. It must have been your many positive reviews that helped our game get noticed by our console publishers! So... a big thank you💖!

If you want to grab a copy…👉[url=https://mizuchigame.com/]https://mizuchigame.com/[/url]

BTW, did you know that [b]more reviews on Steam[/b] can also help Mizuchi reach more gamers? *wink* *wink*😉

[h2]4. Language updates! Chinese and Japanese are coming soon.  [/h2]

Due to our agreement with our console publishers and the Japanese version being released in the upcoming May, the Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese languages will be exclusive to console for a short duration. But we can assure you they'll be available on Steam in the near future as we are making time to check that the new build works properly. We'll make another announcement when the release date is confirmed!

If you want to pre-order the Japanese version, check out the purchase section at [url=https://mizuchigame.com/]https://mizuchigame.com/[/url]

[h2]5. Wishlist our upcoming game - Red Rebellion.[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2114160/Red_Rebellion/

A sapphic fairy tale mashup as Robin Hood teams up with Red Riding Hood to save their town, in this yuri / lesbian historical fantasy set in medieval England.

This time, there’s even more gameplay alongside the same good (if not better) storytelling in Mizuchi.

So, wishlist it now!
